comment: The veraPDF release that scripts/InstallVeraPdf.cs installs for the PDF/A tests. Renovate updates it from the veraPDF/veraPDF-apps release tags. testFilesCommit pins the commit of veraPDF's PDF/A test files (the veraPDF-corpus repository) that scripts/FetchVeraPdfTestFiles.cs fetches; after changing either value, rerun scripts/RecordVeraPdfResults.cs.
